evidence: src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py:79: `return replace(cfg, model=resolve_model_string(STANDARD_CLASS))` — cfg.repo_path is available but not passed.
src/rebar/llm/completion.py:291: `return resolve_model_string(STANDARD_CLASS)` — _verifier_model_for_completion() takes no args, so verify_completion's repo_root/config.repo_path cannot be threaded.

resolve_model_string(value, repo_root=None) -> load_class_slots(None) -> _read_llm_file_table(None) -> read_reserved_section(name, None) -> _discover_project_config(None) which resolves from repo_root(None)/CWD (src/rebar/_config_sources.py:135-146), not the contextvar _active_code_root nor cfg.repo_path.

LLMConfig.from_env(repo_root=repo_root) threads repo_root into _read_llm_file_table for the rest of the cfg (src/rebar/llm/config.py:577), so the model-class table is now read from a different root than the cfg it is applied to.
advisory.finding: Both new call sites resolve the standard class with the default repo_root=None, ignoring cfg.repo_path / the verify_completion repo_root, so the model-class config is discovered from the process CWD rather than the cfg's configured (or attested-snapshot) root.
advisory.suggested_fix: Pass the root through: `resolve_model_string(STANDARD_CLASS, cfg.repo_path)` in _verifier_cfg, and give _verifier_model_for_completion a repo_root parameter forwarded from _verify_completion_inner.

advisory.finding: The completion verifier's model-wiring (completion.py:350, `cfg = replace(cfg, model=_verifier_model_for_completion())`) — the second gate this ticket fixes — is not covered by any test. The new completion test only calls the pure helper `_verifier_model_for_completion()` directly and never asserts that `_verify_completion_inner`/`verify_completion` actually applies the resolved standard-class model onto `cfg.model`. A regression that dropped or broke line 350 would leave the completion verifier running on the operator's/frontier `cfg.model` while every test still passed.
scenarios: A future refactor removes or breaks the `replace(cfg, model=...)` call in `_verify_completion_inner`, silently reverting the completion gate to the frontier/operator model with no failing test — the precise second-gate defect this ticket documents.

evidence: src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py:79: `return replace(cfg, model=resolve_model_string(STANDARD_CLASS))` — cfg.model is now unused in verifier selection

docs/plan-review-gate.md:170-171: "run on the decisive non-frontier `VERIFIER_DEFAULT_MODEL` ... **unless the operator explicitly chose a model** (`REBAR_LLM_MODEL` / `[tool.rebar.llm].model` set to a non-default)" — documents the removed override behavior
docs/llm-framework.md:504: "An explicit non-default `REBAR_LLM_MODEL` still wins." — documents the removed override behavior
docs/plan-review-gate.md:184-186: rationale text still claims the on-cfg downgrade exists so it can "honor an override" / not "override the operator's choice" — now false

An operator who today sets `REBAR_LLM_MODEL=anthropic:claude-opus-4-8` (or any non-default) to run the verifier on a specific model will silently have that choice ignored, with the docs still telling them it is honored.
advisory.finding: Public operator-facing config contract changed without updating its documentation: `REBAR_LLM_MODEL` / `[tool.rebar.llm].model` no longer influences the verifier model, but docs still promise it overrides the downgrade. `docs/plan-review-gate.md:170-171` states the verifier runs the non-frontier model "unless the operator explicitly chose a model (`REBAR_LLM_MODEL` / `[tool.rebar.llm].model` set to a non-default)", and `docs/llm-framework.md:504` states "An explicit non-default `REBAR_LLM_MODEL` still wins" — both now contradict the new code, which resolves the `standard` class regardless of `cfg.model`.
scenarios: Operator sets REBAR_LLM_MODEL to a non-default model expecting the verifier to use it (per docs); the verifier silently uses the `standard` class instead.
A reader following docs/plan-review-gate.md or docs/llm-framework.md to configure the verifier model receives contradictory guidance.
advisory.suggested_fix: Revise docs/plan-review-gate.md:169-186 and docs/llm-framework.md:504 to describe the new contract (verifier = `standard` class, steered by class config, not `REBAR_LLM_MODEL`), matching the docstrings in `_verifier_cfg` and `_verifier_model_for_completion`.
